sql:
WITH segment_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentages AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS percentage_increase
  FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM percentages
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM percentages)
   OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM percentages)

sql:
WITH annual AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS more_male,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'

SELECT l.Date, CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
  AND p.Birthday = (
    SELECT MIN(Birthday)
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
  )
ORDER BY l.Date DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:
SELECT
  r.year,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN length(res.time) - length(replace(res.time, ':', '')) = 2 THEN
        CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
        + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1, 2) AS REAL) * 60
        + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 4) AS REAL)
      ELSE
        CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
        + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
    END
  ) AS avg_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
  AND res.time NOT LIKE '+%'
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

args.query:
SELECT fd.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards AS c2
    JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap'
  )

SELECT s.CharterNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores AS ss
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank, s.CharterNum, ss.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS ss JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC

sql:
SELECT s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND t.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND s.School <> ''
ORDER BY s.School

JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode

     AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types') AS schools_multiple_provision_types,

FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.GSoffered = 'K-8'

SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
    FROM loan AS l2
    JOIN account AS a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997'
      AND a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  )

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
  )

WITH locally_funded AS (
  SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name, s.DOCType AS doc_type,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS difference
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
), avg_difference AS (
  SELECT AVG(difference) AS avg_diff
  FROM locally_funded
)
SELECT school_name, doc_type
FROM locally_funded, avg_difference
WHERE difference > avg_diff

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.County, ss.AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5

args.query:
SELECT c.name, f.text
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND f.language = 'Italian'
